ABOUT FIRMVAULT

Professional work.
Organised records.

FirmVault is a WhatsApp-first document intake, filing, retrieval and audit platform for CA, tax and law practices. It doesn’t replace WhatsApp. It gives your documents a home.

Why we built it

Important documents arrive on WhatsApp and get lost in individual chats. Firms need them to belong to the firm. Documents are stored as Client, Service, Document type, Period.

Security first

Encryption in transit and at rest, group and client-level access, audit trail, and configurable retention.

What’s next

CA and legal editions, then OCR classification, duplicate detection and natural-language search.

Start with your workflow.

Start with a free trial and a 15-minute walkthrough. Send an enquiry to arrange a time and discuss the plan that fits your firm.
